trap.label: pronome repetido
trap.wrong: The cave that we visited it was cold.
trap.right: The cave that we visited was cold.
trap.why: Em português a oração relativa pode vir com pronome retomado na fala (“a caverna que a gente visitou ela”). Em inglês that já é o objeto.

mcq.why: Presente com verbo comum → don’t you.

mcq.q: The woman **___** lives here is a guide.
The valley **___** we camped is beautiful.

fix.wrong: The rock who we found is old.
fix.right: The rock that we found is old.

fix.wrong: He is a man whose he lives in a cave.
fix.right: He is a man who lives in a cave.
fix.why: Whose indica posse; aqui falta só o sujeito who.

rewrite.prompt: Una com where: “This is the valley. We met there.”
rewrite.answer: This is the valley where we met.

rewrite.prompt: Acrescente uma tag: “The cave isn’t deep.”
rewrite.answer: The cave isn’t deep, is it?
